summary: Fix: pinching to zoom out in the PDF reader also opened the Mission Control project overview. The switcher's window-level pinch listeners only ignored the knowledge graph; they now also ignore pinches inside #reader / .pdfbox and, while the reader is open (body.reader-open), never open the overview at all. The ignore rule is a pure function (pinchIgnored) covered by node tests.
scope_note: Owner-reported bug only. Builds on 2026-09-30-project-creation-switcher (same files); commit that unit first.

budget_impact.rationale: Client-side gesture routing and deterministic tests only; no model call, prompt, provider or external request added.
budget_impact.before: Zero model tokens in the reader and project overview.
budget_impact.after: Zero model tokens in the reader and project overview.

checks.note: Run in the owner's terminal because the agent sandbox blocks localhost binds; the evidence file also records the node tests (organization UI, project switcher, profile dashboard).

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; replayed synthetic ctrl+wheel pinches in the browser preview inside the reader (zoom changed, overview stayed closed) and on the main page (overview opened).

open_risks: Verified with synthetic Chromium ctrl+wheel events only; the .app's WKWebView delivers gesturestart/gesturechange, which go through the same ignore check but were not replayed with a real trackpad.
